releases.name: supervisor-workflow
releases.description: Supervisor host and review pipeline: review jobs publish correctly, and the host shuts down and wakes safely.

releases.name: dev-environments
releases.description: Worker and supervisor DevPod workspaces: provisioning, status reporting, and branch checks.

clusters.title: Review job correctness and publication
clusters.description: Review jobs must count as successful when they have no findings, must not file findings twice on resume, and must keep snapshot inventory failures visible to review sync.

clusters.title: Host lifecycle safety: shutdown, wake, and idle observation
clusters.description: The host must refuse shutdown during review jobs, bound discovery before poweroff, verify the webhook before reporting ready, and read job state and leases correctly on boot.

clusters.title: DevPod status and branch checks
clusters.description: Status failures must propagate instead of reading as NotFound, branches that do not exist must not report success, and Remote Control needs full-scope auth. The local stub suite also needs a writable scratch directory.

clusters.title: Worker and supervisor DevPod provisioning
clusters.description: Provision independent worker and supervisor workspaces through the existing path, package their setup, and extract the container-use and Dagger installers into devcontainer features.

clusters.title: Duo question cards: stale option preview
clusters.description: The Duo demo claim's cards are defined in Pkl (CIT-465), and replacing cards must clear the old option preview. It ships with the iPhone Duo editor.
